Name: NPC Bucket for HB
Author: shounlol
Description:
[b]New Update: Message customization for each character. GMCM support for editing configuration.[/b]

This mod allows the player to use the Milk Pail on [u]adult male NPCs[/u] and obtain their 'milk' from [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors mod[/url]. This mod will not work without that mod as it only gives the player [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors'[/url] cum bottles. *Image is not actual gameplay*

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2564]Horny Bachelors mod[/url] by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/34349595]Girafarig[/url].
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[size=5]How to use[/size]
Go up to an adult male NPC, hold a [url=https://www.stardewvalleywiki.com/Milk_Pail]Milk Pail[/url], and click on the bottom half of their sprite and reap the rewards.

To customize message after milking NPC, simply edit the config.json file, which is created after running the mod for the first time, and then reload the game.
You can also use [url=http://https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098?tab=description]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to edit the config.json in-game and the mod automatically reloads the config so that you don't have to restart the game after doing any changes.

[size=5]Compatibility[/size][list][*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6+ on Linux/macOS/Windows.
[*]Ensure you don't have another mod that triggers an event when a male NPC is clicked on [b]With a Milk Pail[/b].
[/list][size=5]Feedback
[/size]Feel free to dm or leave any feedback/suggestions for the mod or other mod requests.
